description: A composite group of 27 sub-images correlating EBSD phase maps with in-situ µ-DIC shear-strain fields for the RD sample of a low-density medium-Mn steel. (a1) is an EBSD phase + BC map of the entire probed area (100 µm scale bar, labelled RD): banded gray BCC δ-ferrite alternating with cyan FCC γ+α; a red rectangular frame marks the UFG γ+α region. (a2)-(a5) are the shear-strain fields of that area at 5, 10, 15 and 20% engineering strain (100 µm bars), turning from dark blue to red/white with increasing strain on the shared 0-30 shear strain (%) colour bar. (b1)-(b5) repeat the phase map plus four strain fields for the magnified UFG region (5 µm bars). (c1)-(c5) and (d1)-(d5) show the same fields masked to the FCC phase (cyan) and BCC phase (gray) alone (5 µm bars). Red arrows in (a5) mark deformation slip bands; arrows in (d5) mark strain concentration near phase boundaries; small white boxes "1" and "2" in (a5) locate the profile lines. Bottom legend: cyan = FCC, gray = BCC, plus a double-headed loading-direction arrow. (e1) black and (e2) red line profiles of shear strain (%) versus distance (µm) across δ and γ+α, separated by a vertical dashed line, each with an inset strain map. No numeric strain values are printed on the maps themselves.

observations.observation: (a1) is an EBSD phase + band-contrast map of the entire probed area of the RD sample with a 100 µm scale bar, showing a banded structure of gray BCC/δ-ferrite alternating with cyan FCC γ+α; a red rectangle marks the UFG γ+α region reproduced in (b1).
The five maps in each row (a), (b), (c), (d) are labelled 5%, 10%, 15% and 20% engineering strain along with the undeformed map, i.e. shear-strain fields at four strain levels.
A shared horizontal colour bar at the bottom is labelled Shear Strain (%) with tick values 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30, running from dark blue (0) through cyan/green/yellow to red (30).
The bottom legend identifies cyan as FCC and gray as BCC, and a double-headed horizontal arrow marks the loading direction.
(a5) (20% strain) contains red arrows marking deformation slip bands, and two small white boxes labelled 1 and 2 that correspond to the inset strain maps of (e1) and (e2).
(d5) (BCC strain map at 20% strain) contains arrows marking strain concentration near phase boundaries.

Panels (e1) and (e2) are line profiles with y-axis 'Shear Strain (%)' spanning 8 to 20 and x-axis 'Distance (µm)' with ticks at 0, 2, 4 and 6; each has a vertical dashed line separating a left region labelled δ from a right region labelled γ+α, and each profile fluctuates through a band roughly between 13% and 18% shear strain.
Scale bars differ by row: (a) maps are labelled 100 µm, while (b), (c) and (d) maps are labelled 5 µm.
The strain distribution across the entire probed region of the RD sample is relatively uniform, indicating that δ-ferrite and UFG γ+α exhibit similar deformation levels.
At higher strain (20%), deformation slip bands are visible, marked by arrows in Fig. 10(a5).

At high magnification the UFG region shows a more heterogeneous strain distribution, especially at strain levels above 15%, attributed to the different deformation behaviors of austenite and α-ferrite.

Strain concentration near phase boundaries, marked by arrows in Fig. 10(d5), is observed at higher plastic deformation levels above 15%, consistent with strain incompatibility between austenite and ferrite.
The caption states that (c1)-(c5) are the single-phase FCC maps of the (b1) area and (d1)-(d5) are the single-phase BCC maps of the same area.

The caption states that (a2-a5), (b2-b5), (c2-c5) and (d2-d5) show the shear-strain distribution of the areas in (a1), (b1), (c1) and (d1), respectively, at engineering strains from 5% to 20%, and that (e) shows local strain across different representative phase regions along the arrow marked in the inset strain maps.

subfigures.description: EBSD phase + band-contrast map of the whole probed RD-sample area, 100 µm scale bar, showing banded gray BCC/δ-ferrite interleaved with cyan FCC γ+α; a red rectangle marks the UFG γ+α region enlarged in (b1).

Shear-strain distribution maps of the (a1) area at 5%, 10%, 15% and 20% engineering strain, 100 µm scale bar, on the 0-30 shear strain (%) colour bar. Strain rises progressively and becomes heterogeneous; (a5) contains red arrows marking deformation slip bands and white boxes labelled 1 and 2 marking profile positions.
Magnified EBSD phase + BC map of the UFG γ+α region (red frame in a1), 5 µm scale bar, labelled UFG; shows islands of FCC (cyan) in a BCC (gray) matrix.
Shear-strain maps of the UFG region at 5%-20% engineering strain, 5 µm scale bar; increasingly heterogeneous with red/yellow high-strain streaks appearing above 15%.
Single-phase FCC map of the (b1) area (cyan, labelled FCC, 5 µm scale bar) followed by its shear-strain fields at 5%-20%; the FCC pixels are shown with strain colour, BCC pixels blanked.
Single-phase BCC map of the (b1) area (gray, labelled BCC, 5 µm scale bar) followed by its shear-strain fields at 5%-20%; (d5) contains arrows marking strain concentration near phase boundaries.

Line profile of shear strain (%) versus distance (µm) as black open circles, with a vertical dashed line separating a region labelled δ (left) from one labelled γ+α (right); inset strain map shows box 1 and a white arrow along which the profile was taken. Strain fluctuates between roughly 13% and 18%.

Second line profile of shear strain (%) versus distance (µm) as red open circles with a red dashed line separating δ from γ+α; inset strain map shows box 2 with a white arrow. Strain fluctuates over a similar ~12-17% band.

unreadable_items: Colour-scale saturated (white) pixels in (b5), (c5) and (d5) cannot be assigned a precise shear-strain value beyond the red end of the 0-30% bar
Inset strain maps in (e1) and (e2) are too small to read individual strain values or the full extent of the profile arrow
